assetName.description: name of the asset to withdraw e.g. `AUD` or `BTC`

toAddress.description: destination address for crypto withdrawal. mandatory for crypto assets. For `XRP` withdrawals, you can optionally add destination tag to the address with `?dt=12345` e.g. `1EJKj147QmEzywLnLpuxSr6SoPr1p62VBX?dt=123456`

accountName.description: optional for AUD withdrawal. when not specified default bank information is used

accountNumber.description: optional for AUD withdrawal. when not specified default bank information is used

bsbNumber.description: optional for AUD withdrawal. when not specified default bank information is used

bankName.description: optional for AUD withdrawal. when not specified default bank information is used

paymentDescription.description: optional for AUD withdrawal. Maximum character length of 18 and only alphanumeric
